Name: Friendship Plus
Author: scotteh101
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Friendship Plus adds three configurable tweaks to villager friendship: a multiplier on all friendship gains, passive friendship from simply being near villagers, and shared friendship between co-op players that pools everyone's progress overnight. Everything is tunable through Generic Mod Config Menu, so you can dial in exactly how generous (or vanilla) you want it to feel.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*](Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for an in-game settings menu.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Friendship multiplier[/b] — scales friendship gained from talking, gifting, quests, etc. by a configurable factor. Daily decay is never scaled, only positive gains.[/*]
[*][b]Disable friendship decay[/b] — optional toggle so friendship never drops from neglecting a villager.[/*]
[*][b]Passive proximity friendship[/b] — slowly build friendship just by standing near villagers you've already met. Configurable radius, gain rate, and a daily cap per villager.[/*]
[*][b]Whole-building range[/b] — separate toggles for the Community Center, the Saloon, and (optionally) every indoor location, so you don't need to hug each villager individually.[/*]
[*][b]Festival support[/b] — proximity gains work correctly during festivals, with an option to count every attendee instead of just those near you.[/*]
[*][b]Co-op shared friendship[/b] — in multiplayer, each player's daily friendship gains are pooled and applied to everyone overnight. Choose between 
[code]sum[/code] (everyone gets the total — co-op befriends ~Nx faster) or a blended 
[code]average[/code] mode with a slider between true average and the top contributor's gain.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional) — required only for the in-game config menu; without it, edit 
[code]config.json[/code] directly in the mod folder[/*]
[/list]
